lines.zh: 手臂拖在地上，划出一道黑痕。
lines.en: My arm drags on the ground, leaving a black streak.
Fingertips drag along the stone wall.
I slide along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 一只空手悬着，慢慢握紧。
lines.en: An empty hand hovers and slowly clenches.
My knuckles tap softly in the dark.
Five fingers spread behind the wall.
I wait for your mind to snap.
My wrist hangs still in midair.

lines.zh: 一只手从余光里伸出来。
lines.en: A hand reaches out from the corner of your eye.

lines.zh: 我没有眼睛，也知道你在哪。
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I know where you are.

lines.zh: 手指一根根张开，朝向你。
lines.en: My fingers open one by one, toward you.

lines.zh: 手腕转了半圈，正对着你。
lines.en: My wrist turns half a circle, facing you.

lines.zh: 一只手臂，从影子里伸出来。
lines.en: One arm reaches out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 我只有一条手臂，也够抓你。
lines.en: One arm is enough to grab you.

lines.zh: 手从墙缝里伸出来，正在看你。
lines.en: A hand reaches from the wall crack, watching you.
I watch you from behind the dandelion.
A finger points at your nape.
You catch me in the corner of your eye.

lines.zh: 药片吃得越多我越清楚
lines.en: The more pills you take, the clearer I become.

lines.zh: 我的手指在你余光里张开。
lines.en: My fingers open at the edge of your vision.

lines.zh: 你的影子朝我偏了一点
lines.en: Your shadow leans a little toward me.
I hide at the edge of your sight.
A fingernail scratches at your window.
A pain echoes in the dark.

lines.zh: 指节断了，影子漏出黑雾。
lines.en: My knuckle snaps; black mist leaks out.
I feel the torture of pain.
It's eyeing you. Watch out for the arms.

lines.zh: 那股腐味，让我的手指发痒。
lines.en: That rotten smell makes my fingers itch.
In the dark, I'm your nightmare.

lines.zh: 你的身体撞上我的触手。
lines.en: Your body collides with my arms.

lines.zh: 你的力量碰触我的影子。
你撞上的是影子，不是墙。
lines.en: You hit a shadow, not a wall.

lines.zh: 你的撞击唤醒我的本能。

lines.en: Dance with shadows, be with me.

lines.zh: 影子间的默契，无需言语。
成为我的伴侣，共享黑暗。
lines.en: Be my mate, share the darkness.

lines.zh: 我们的影子，我们的纽带。

lines.en: Feel the shadow, dance with me.

lines.zh: 腐烂的东西，我用手掌捧住。
lines.en: I cup the rotting thing in my palm.

lines.zh: 这只手从地板缝里伸出来。
lines.en: This hand reaches through the floor seam.

lines.zh: 我攥住那点残渣，不松手。
lines.en: I clutch that scrap and will not let go.

lines.zh: 手臂从影子里伸出来抓你。
lines.en: An arm reaches out of the shadow for you.

lines.zh: 墙角的影子动了一下，是我。
lines.en: The shadow in the corner stirs. It is me.
The stench of carrion draws me.
When your mind breaks, I arrive.
The shadow henchman leads me in.
My fingers have closed around you.
Your fear has fed me fat.
The vision clears, and I reach out.

lines.zh: 这只手从墙里伸出来了！
lines.en: This hand has come out of the wall!

lines.zh: 我只是一条影子手臂，伸出来就抓。
lines.en: Only a shadow arm, reaching out to grab.
My fingertips already rest on your shoulder.
My arm reaches through the wall for you.
My whole arm wraps around you.
A hand comes out of your shadow.
Don't switch off the light; I live in it.
My knuckles tighten one by one.
Wherever you run, I can reach.
One twist of the wrist locks you in.
What I grab is your sanity.

lines.zh: 五根手指先掐住你的影子。
lines.en: Five fingers clamp your shadow first.

lines.zh: 黑暗里伸出的这条手臂，够得着你。
lines.en: This arm out of the dark can reach you.

lines.zh: 一只手臂，从你的影子里伸出来。
lines.en: An arm reaches out of your shadow.
Five fingers slap across your face.
I grab you by the collar.
A flick of my wrist drops you to the floor.
This blow comes from behind you.
The dark bites into your arm.
Your pain makes me more real.
I slap the pills out of your hand.

lines.zh: 黑暗中伸出来的一只手。
lines.en: A hand reaching out of the dark.

lines.zh: 一只手臂从墙角伸出来。
lines.en: An arm reaches out from the corner.
The shadow henchman is missing a hand.
I grow out of the corner.
A hand appears in the dark.
I take shape when your sanity hits zero.
The pills fail, and here I am.
A hand lands on your shoulder first.
I gather the shadow into an arm.
A hand reaches out of the nightmare.
I crawl out with the shadow henchman.

lines.zh: 火燎过手背，影子缩了一圈。
lines.en: Fire sears my hand; the shadow shrinks.

lines.zh: 箭插在影子里，拔不出来。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in the shadow and will not come out.

lines.zh: 这只手空着，连影子都饿。
lines.en: This hand is empty, even the shadow hungers.

lines.zh: 虚空的寒冷渗透我的皮肤。
lines.en: The void's cold seeps into my skin.
